page_note: Page contains two cosmological teaching units interrupted by an editorial seam. Segments 0-6 enumerate seventh and eighth thrones (Great King of Honor, Judge of Truth, three ways) — clean cosmological substrate. Segments 7-11 mark a CLASSIC EDITORIAL SEAM: the ninth throne is identified as 'the apostle in the holy Church... who has come unto our feet at this time' — pattern mimicry that extends the cosmic throne enumeration to the contemporary institution. Segs 12-16 (damaged) summarize 'these nine thrones in this cosmos.' New chapter on the Three Garments begins at seg 17-18 (rubric/heading), opens with frame at seg 19 ('he said to his disciples'), then the Living Spirit's investiture with the three garments (wind/fire/water) is recounted — substantive cosmological substrate teaching, though with hortatory vocative 'my beloved ones' inserted at seg 20. Editorial fatigue score signals dialogue/hortatory drift in second half, consistent with chapter break and frame insertion.
